title: structured output: improve constrained-decoding backends for CFG/regex and tokenizer edge cases
author: Jordan Kim
description: Motivation: constrained decoding (CFG/regex backends) has produced incorrect or unstable structured-output streaming in a few customer edgecases. Root causes identified: (1) regex constraint checks were run on raw token strings instead of tokenizer-aligned token pieces leading to false negatives; (2) CFG backend did not handle epsilon productions and optional fields robustly in streaming mode; (3) tokenizer boundary mismatches caused constraint enforcement to accept/deny partial tokens incorrectly; (4) streaming path did not always propagate backend state on early yields causing downstream tool-calling errors. This PR: - Adds tokenizer-aware regex matching utilities that operate on token id sequences and reconstructed token spans so regex constraints align with tokenizer behavior. - Introduces a normalized "token-span" representation used by all constrained-decoding backends to avoid byte/char offset mismatches. - Fixes CFG streaming state machine to support epsilon/optional productions and to checkpoint/serialize state during early streaming yields. - Adds fallback heuristics: when tokenizer ambiguity prevents a definitive constraint decision, we use conservative allowlist-first behaviour and emit debug traces (guarded by trace flag). - Adds comprehensive unit and integration tests for tokenizer edgecases (multi-byte unicode, byte-pair splits, whitespace-prefixed tokens), regex anchors across token boundaries, and CFG optional nodes. - Improves logging and exposes a new structured_output.trace config for customers to enable verbose constraint diagnostics. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for tokenizer-aware regex matcher - [x] Streaming integration tests for CFG optional productions - [x] Backwards-compatible API for OpenAI-compat structured output constraints - [x] Performance tests to validate <5% p50 token latency regression in constrained mode - [x] Docs updates and changelog entry Related: ENG-3042 (internal evals), ENG-3120 (streaming reliability). Notes: this change touches critical runtime paths; we added a safety toggle (structured_output.strict_tokenizer_matching=false) to roll back to prior behavior if needed.

review_comments: Aisha Patel (review): Can you clarify how the token-span maps to original string offsets when there are trailing spaces? Also request a small benchmark showing p50 impact.

Jordan Kim (author): Token-span stores (token_id, token_text, start_byte, end_byte) and we normalize spaces by canonicalizing leading/trailing whitespace into explicit token spans; added microbenchmark in tests (see performance section).
Marco Chen (review): The fallback heuristic sounds safe, but we should make sure it cannot be abused to bypass constraints. Recommend telemetry events for fallback triggers.
Jordan Kim (author): Added telemetry event structured_output.constraint_fallback with reason tags; limits on event volume enforced in telemetry layer.
Leah O'Connor (approval): Tests look comprehensive. Verified integration run locally. Approving after minor lint fix.
merge_commit_message:
structured output: tokenizer-aligned constrained-decoding (CFG/regex) and streaming fixes

Add tokenizer-aware regex matcher, token-span normalization, streaming-safe CFG state machine, tests, docs, and a safety toggle. (ENG-3042, ENG-3120)
release_notes: Fix: Structured-output constrained decoding now correctly handles tokenizer edgecases (multi-byte unicode, BPE splits, whitespace tokens) and streaming CFG optional productions. Added config flag structured_output.strict_tokenizer_matching for rollback and structured_output.trace for diagnostics.
